description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Layout' class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Design namespace. The class provides methods for managing layout entities in the OpenCart system, including CRUD operations for layouts, routes, and modules. The file includes function definitions for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving layouts and their associated routes and modules.
external_files: database schema for layout and related tables

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: A class responsible for managing layout entities, including creation, updating, deletion, and retrieval, along with associated routes and modules in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Creates a new layout record; optionally adds associated layout routes and modules.

methods.name: editLayout
methods.description: Updates an existing layout and its associated routes and modules.

methods.name: deleteLayout
methods.description: Deletes a layout and all related routes, modules, and associated data across other models.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific layout by its ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of layouts with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLayouts
methods.description: Returns the total count of layout records.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a routing entry for a specific layout.

methods.name: deleteRoutes
methods.description: Deletes all routes associated with a specific layout.

methods.name: deleteRoutesByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes route entries filtered by layout ID.

methods.name: deleteRoutesByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes route entries filtered by store ID.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Retrieves all routes associated with a specific layout.

methods.name: getRoutesByStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves routes filtered by store ID.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a module to a specific layout.

methods.name: deleteModules
methods.description: Deletes all modules associated with a specific layout.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Deletes modules matching a specific code.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves modules associated with a specific layout.
